finalText:
Builds clean now: 0 errors. The 8 remaining lines are genuine deprecation noise from the bumped deps (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, sync loader hooks, `punycode`, `module.parent`), not bugs — nothing to fix there.

The real breakage was two call sites the bundler bump silently broke:
- `src/core/options.js:6` — read `options.retries` but the new bundler passes `retryCount`; threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — treated an unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid instead of `false`, since the new config loader leaves it `undefined` rather than `false`.
